scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @questwright/engine && npm run typecheck -w @questwright/web && npm run typecheck -w @questwright/desktop
scripts.desktop:stage: npm run build -w @questwright/web && npm run stage -w @questwright/desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run desktop:stage && npm run start -w @questwright/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:stage && npm run dist -w @questwright/desktop
